## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle Dharmaguptaka *karmavācanā* compendium for the **nuns' saṅgha**, compiled by **Huáisù** ([懷素](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%87%B7%E7%B4%A0)) of the *Dōng-tǎ* school of *Sìfēn lǜ* Vinaya. Companion text to the *Sēng jiémó* ([KR6k0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0047)) and parallel in approach. Composed at Cháng'ān in the second half of the 7th century.

**Abstract**

The *Ní jiémó* presents the *karmavācanā* formulae for the *bhikṣuṇī*-saṅgha — *upasaṃpadā* (with the dual-saṅgha procedure), *uposatha*, *pravāraṇā*, the *aṣṭa-gurudharma* recitation, and the various *bhikṣuṇī*-specific procedures. The text supplied the practical handbook for the conduct of *bhikṣuṇī* legal acts in the Dōng-tǎ tradition. Like the parallel *Sēng jiémó*, it was eclipsed by Dàoxuān's lineage in the late Tang but retained authority in the Sòng under Yuánzhào's recovery.
